beats.what: Lynn reads her booklet cover and finds the hall has been split into two different exam sets, breaking her code
Bank leaves his desk to report the cheating to the invigilator, who leans back and waves him off
Lynn holds back the code and works out she must answer both sets herself
Lynn taps out the Set 1 answers as finger code and her clients fill in their sheets
With the hall emptying Lynn finishes Set 2 and drums out the second code before time is called
The answers spread through a LINE group chat while Pat counts the takings on the steps
Two students hauled into the office crack and tell the staff the exam leaked and that there were two sets
The teacher accuses Bank of leaking the exam and holds Lynn back for questioning
The headmistress confronts Lynn in front of her father with evidence she sat the exam for Pat, and Pat puts the fee at 3,000 baht
Lynn hits back that the school takes money too, naming the two million baht her father paid it
Lynn's father begs for her place and the headmistress lets her stay but cuts her Singapore scholarship
At his scholarship interview Bank tells the panel Lynn cheated and that he is nothing like her
Her father opens Lynn's bank passbook and confronts her across the dinner table over the money
